source.author: verg
source.text: Heu, terra ignota canibus data praeda Latinis alitibusque iaces, nec te, tua funera mater produxi pressive oculos aut volnera lavi, veste tegens, tibi quam noctes festina diesque urgebam et tela curas solabar anilis.
source.text_original: Heu, terra ignota canibus data praeda Latinis / alitibusque iaces, nec te, tua funera mater / produxi pressive oculos aut volnera lavi, / veste tegens, tibi quam noctes festina diesque / urgebam et tela curas solabar anilis.
source.text_english: Alas, you lie there, prey given to Latin dogs and birds of prey, on unknown ground; and I did not lead out your funeral rites or press your eyes closed or wash your wounds, mother though I was, covering you with my garment, for whom through hasty nights and days I used to urge on the loom and console my old woman’s cares with the work.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_original: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque / auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_english: Give me, I beg, your embrace, and leave your words to cling to my ears, and now at last close my eyes with your sweet right hand.
